text_block_list.text: No luck... No matter how much I try!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This full-course Overlord cuisine is
designed to
channel my beauty to all
five senses.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Appearance! Aroma! Texture! Every
ingredient
uniting in harmony with each
bite!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Each piece is perfectly linked... Yet after
all these
attempts, the most vital
element, my beauty,
remains absent
from the flavor...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Must I suffer to taste this vacuous
meal
once again?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Spe, what's that yearning in your
eye?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
N-nothing! I just... smelled something
really
yummy and heard the word
"taste," so...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Truly?! You wish to sample the flavor?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But to impart to you a beauty that is yet

incomplete... As the Overlord, I could
not
possibly—
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Opera O! We're friends, aren't we?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Let me help you! For the sake of your
yum—um,
perfectly beautiful cuisine!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Spe! You kind soul! I entrust the
star's role to
you!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О doesn't sample even a
bite of her
food and slims down as a
result.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
